additional_info.subject: Issue Description
additional_info.body:
Abnormal Fan Noise – SICHARGE D Charging Station
Charging Station Details:
Station ID: 1000116972
Display Name: 103107-04
Location: Aire de Royan Vercors - A49, 26730 LA BAUMED'HOSTUN, France
Manufacturer / Model: Siemens AG – SICHARGE D
Issue Description:
We have observed an abnormal and repetitive noise coming from
the internal fans of the charging station.
The sound suggests that the fan blades might be coming into
contact with internal wiring or components, potentially indicating a
mechanical misalignment or obstruction.
Please investigate and advise on any necessary corrective actions.
Best regards,
Yacine KEDIA
